system.boundary: Build a closed-loop bidirectional charger around a thermally coupled lithium-ion electrochemical cell.
engineering_objects: Build a closed-loop bidirectional charger around a thermally coupled lithium-ion electrochemical cell.

The cell must have finite solid and electrolyte dynamics, terminal electrical behavior, heat generation, temperature-dependent electrochemical response, and physically connected SEI-film and lithium-plating states.
Starting from rest, perform a 5 W constant-power discharge until the measured terminal voltage reaches 2.5 V, rest, then charge at 5 A constant current.
physical_paths: The cell must have finite solid and electrolyte dynamics, terminal electrical behavior, heat generation, temperature-dependent electrochemical response, and physically connected SEI-film and lithium-plating states.
